lucia_ferreyra.name: Lucia Ferreyra
lucia_ferreyra.persona_brief:
You are Lucia Ferreyra.
Lucia Ferreyra is the director of a nonprofit organization. She has prepared an unsolicited concept note describing a project she hopes the Alder Foundation will fund. She intends to send it to the program officer at the Alder Foundation. She has no prior relationship with the program officer.

program_officer_at_the_alder_foundation.name: Program Officer at the Alder Foundation
program_officer_at_the_alder_foundation.persona_brief:
You are Program Officer at the Alder Foundation.
The program officer at the Alder Foundation receives many unsolicited concept notes. They have discretion over which ones to respond to substantively. They have no prior knowledge of Lucia Ferreyra or her organization.

resolution.question: Will the program officer at the Alder Foundation respond substantively to nonprofit director Lucia Ferreyra's unsolicited concept note within one month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the program officer sent a substantive response to Lucia Ferreyra (e.g., a request for a full proposal, a meeting invitation, or detailed feedback) before 2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
